notes.title: The Kindeman Remedy Patch #5 and Consoles Launch
notes.content:
Greetings everyone,

Today we have a small new update for you that addresses some minor issues and also adds a few new features! We have also added Catalan language. You can find the full list down below.

Additionally, today we are happy to let you know that The Kindeman Remedy will be available on PS4|5, Xbox Series and Xbox One, and also the Nintendo Switch! For those of you who would like to try the game on consoles, you now have the option to do so! You can watch the trailer [url=https://youtu.be/TLzt9x23HIw]here[/url].

[list]
[*] Added a new 'special treatment' to unlock: the Bath Tub
[*] Added Screen Resolution option to Graphic Settings
[*] Added Catalan localization
[*] Added 'special treatments' list in the Prescription Book: you can check which treatments you already performed on inmates
[*] Fixed some cutscenes: corrected some compenetrations with objects
[*] Fixed Drips and Poison tutorial: locked useless doors during tutorials
[/list]

notes.title: The Kindeman Remedy - Patch #4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793718/e52f07b9d8d2cb643a25149ffa47b738e638da6c.png[/img]

Hey everyone, we've got a small new update just in time for the holidays for you!

[list]
[*] [b]NEW![/b]: We added a brand new gameplay section for Sister Anna; she can now make poison from mushrooms and pesticide into the Warehouse [i](Please note that you'll need to start a new run in order to do it)[/i]
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Oliver's behavior when carrying bodies; now he'll take bodies to the incinerator as intended 
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] an issue where lights in the Drip Room were off during gameplay
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] an issue where players would unlock Pills Dispenser 2, but be unable to use it
[*] [b]Refactored[/b] the Daytime/Nighttime Report UI with improved icons and layout
[/list]
If you're just discovering the game, you can pick it up for[b] 10% off during the Steam Winter Sale[/b] ⬇️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2055410/The_Kindeman_Remedy/

We'll see you all in the new year! Happy holidays everyone, and thank you for all your feedback and support on The Kindeman Remedy!

notes.title: The Kindeman Remedy - Patch #3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793718/becb7ccbdf558b57c2879ff14f9f50bd22aac93c.png[/img]

Greetings everyone,

We are back with a new update that addresses some of the issues that have been reported by the community! Once again, thanks to everyone for sharing your feedback with us!

Here is the list of what is included with this update:

[list]
[*] [b]Added[/b] camera pan (hold the right mouse button or use the gamepad's right stick)
[*] [b]Added[/b] Enhanced Lighting to Graphic Settings
[*] [b]Added[/b] Gore Death for poisoned inmates (you need to enable the Gore option in the Game Settings Tab)
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] the assistant's velocity when he's carrying a corpse
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] some cutscenes
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Percy's dialogues
[*] Made object icons [b]clickable [/b](you can interact with an object by clicking on its icon as well)
[*] Room icons appear as soon as an inmate enters a room
[*] Replaced Corpse Disposal with [b]Incinerator[/b]
[*] Greyed out [b]inactive [/b]rooms
[*] [b]Increased [/b]Freight Lifter speed
[*] [b]Increased [/b]guard's speed when he's dropping a corpse in the Morgue
[*] [b]Increased [/b]Chemical Desk speed
[*] [b]Increased [/b]Morgue Table speed
[/list]

notes.title: The Kindeman Remedy - Patch #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793718/9ef9ea3940fb6f65f7f84da5f357f8a101832cf7.png[/img]

Greetings everyone,

Not so long since we released the first patch, we've already prepared the second update that addresses several issues and bugs that we've managed to fix based on your feedback!

Without further ado, here is the list of everything that this update includes:

[list]
[*] [b]FIXED[/b]: Inmates stuck at the end of the day
[*] [b]FIXED[/b]: Execution cutscene incongruences
[*] [b]FIXED[/b]: Crash related to Secret Room
[*] [b]FIXED[/b]: Pause Menu stuck in Settings
[*] [b]IMPROVED[/b]: Changed/improved Interactable positions in some rooms (Lab / Drip Room) to allow for faster gameplay
[*] [b]IMPROVED[/b]: We switched to a new rendering system for enhanced graphics/lighting. This system requires DX12 compatible cards though. The game was tested on a nvidia GeForce RTX 3060 (with steady 60fps) and nvidia GeForce GTX 1050 (around 20-22fps). In order to test this new system you need to switch to the Beta Branch on Steam (read the instructions below)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793718/290df8ddf6e3d7fc29c3d576abaa9e9d51de8e69.png[/img]

[h3]How do I opt-in in the Beta Branch?[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793718/841513f63d13bf4f46b167a9d7e880a6b44f46c4.png[/img]

A - Right-click on the The Kindeman Remedy in your Steam client's [b]Library tab[/b]

B - Select the Betas option on the left [b](1)[/b], then type [i]TheKindemanRemedyBeta[/i] into the text field [b](2)[/b] and click on the [b]Check Code[/b] button [b](3)[/b]

C - Click on the [b]Opt into: beta - Experimental features[/b] button

Thanks again to everyone sharing feedback! Stay tuned for more updates coming in the future.

notes.title: The Kindeman Remedy - Patch 1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793718/49627c47cee818cc4ca6117b4e7ebaaacf8df13c.png[/img]

[b]We heard you loud and clear[/b]: on popular demand, we [b]increased Dr. Kindeman and Oliver's movement speed[/b] while carrying bodies down in the Morgue.

Now you also have [b]4 carts[/b] for the drips.

While we were at it, we [b]fixed some localization problems[/b] (especially with Italian language) and other game loading bugs.

Here's the full change list:

[list]
[*] Increased characters' movement speed while carrying bodies (Kindeman/Oliver)
[*] Localization: fixed wrong tags in Italian localization
[*] Fixed Oliver (assistant)'s behavior
[*] Fixed Phone bug when loading a game
[*] Fixed Pippi bug when loading a game
[*] Added Drip Cart N.4
[*] Fixed Minor and Major Report values when loading a game
[*] Fixed Sister Anna's cloth mesh compenetrations
[*] Added a new Credits screen
[/list]

Enjoy and stay tuned for more improvements/fixes/updates in the next few days!

-- Troglobytes

notes.title: The Kindeman Remedy Launches on 16 November!
notes.content:
Hey folks! With only 3 days left til the launch of [b]The Kindeman Remedy[/b] on [b]Nov 16th[/b] at [b]1pm EST[/b] / [b]7pm CET[/b], we wanted to take the time to send out this helpful update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793718/ef1e6182f28e8ed01e056a122b81078163c6ab32.png[/img]

[h2]Prices[/h2]

 $7.99 USD / €7.99 EUR / £6.69 GBP / China ¥33.00 / Japan ¥890 

[h2]Live Stream[/h2]

If you wanna see the game before grabbing it, good news! [i]3D Realms Live![/i] streams will be dedicated to [b]The Kindeman Remedy[/b] which you can watch [url=https://www.twitch.tv/3drealms]here[/url] at 2pm EST/8pm CEST on Thursday and Friday.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793718/ef1e6182f28e8ed01e056a122b81078163c6ab32.png[/img]

Details about any additional stores will be announced when they are ready.
